_source: W46.ocr-new-open's Sherlock run of the untested open readers on the 895 frozen public pages, through the open sweep's own harness (scripts/segbench/sherlock/new-open/setup-job.sh: open_sweep_setup.py, the frozen ocr_run.py collector, open_sweep_run.py), submitted 2026-10-22 and collected 2026-10-24 into ~/Library/Caches/ArchiveSuiteRehearsal/sherlock-results/new-open-895 (execution-plans/items/W46.ocr-new-open.md). Scores: segbench-results/bench-corpus/new-open-sherlock-20261024.{json,csv} from corpus/farmshare_expanded_report.py against the open sweep's own manifests. Models, revisions, prompts and weight sizes from each model's prepared.json and status.json; server minutes from the first to the last timestamp of the model's vLLM log, model load included.
status: Same settings as the open sweep, on Sherlock rather than FarmShare. Nothing adopted.
hardware: One Sherlock GPU with 48 or 80 GB (Slurm constraint GPU_MEM:48GB|GPU_MEM:80GB) per model, vLLM 0.31.0, context 16384, temperature 0, thinking off, 8192 output tokens, 16 sequences and 8 concurrent requests.

xiaomi-ocr-0.prompt: the card's Markdown prompt (main body, OTSL tables, LaTeX formulas, headers and footers ignored)

not_scored.state: Sherlock 2026-10-22: the three-page pilot capped or came back empty, so open_sweep_run.py stopped before the full run (status needs_inspection). No 96 run.
Sherlock 2026-10-22: vLLM 0.31 does not support its rotary embedding; no reading on either set.
Skipped at setup: the installed vLLM does not support the architecture, and the run allows no environment upgrade.

Not submitted: each needs more than the frozen collector's one image and one prompt (its own vLLM image or logits processor, a vLLM range of 0.20-0.26, DocTags special tokens, or a full prompt and JSON or HTML output not on the card).
